description: The REPOSITORY FUNCTION entry — §2023:12.3.8.2's intrinsic-function-specifier (`FUNCTION ALL INTRINSIC` / `FUNCTION { intrinsic-function-name-1 } … INTRINSIC`) and user-defined-function-specifier (`FUNCTION function-prototype-name-1 [AS literal-5]`) — introduced 2002 with the REPOSITORY paragraph itself: the '85 CONFIGURATION SECTION has no REPOSITORY paragraph. Introduction-gated post-bind by VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitRepositoryEntry beside its CLASS/INTERFACE/PROGRAM/PROPERTY siblings; below 2002 the gate names the edition (COBOL0900). It is also THE edition fact the keyword-omitted function reference reads (§2023:8.4.3.2.3 SR2 allows the omission only for a name the REPOSITORY declares): IntrinsicBinder.KeywordOmittedFunction is inert where the entry is not available, and the reserved-name arm (SUM, SIGN, RANDOM, LENGTH) reaches only a REPOSITORY the gate has already refused (kb/Work PB2589).
vcr: kb/Work PB2589 — the keyword-omitted reserved intrinsic compiled at --std 85 because the declaration that licenses the omission was ungated
